# Status: NOT IMPLEMENTED

## Purpose

Define shared policy/reference guidance for resilient and safe M365 agent and Power Platform designs.

## Boundaries

This is a policy/reference skill, not an implementation engine and not a substitute for Microsoft platform validation.

## Inputs and outputs (planned)

- Inputs: approved architecture/specification and applicable environment/policy facts.
- Outputs: documented resilience requirements, review findings, and escalation guidance.

## Dependencies (planned, unverified)

Project specification and capability evidence; Microsoft platform capabilities for any implementation or validation work.

## References

See `references/` for planned resilience, identity/permission, and side-effect contracts.
